facebook.content:
Family – Unity in the Spirit

Our homes are under attack, yet the blood of Jesus secures every household.  

Father, we declare that every family in our city walks in divine unity, love, and purpose.  The spirit of discord is broken; the throne of peace reigns.  Let every father, mother, child and spouse reflect Christ’s character, and let the household be a beacon of Kingdom authority.  

If you stand in agreement, drop a 🙏.  Share your prayer need below.

Family — Our homes are under attack by division and fear.  
Father, we declare Your peace reigns over every hearth.  The Spirit of unity breaks every stronghold; love binds us tighter than any discord.  We claim the promise of Psalm 133: “Your blessing is on the whole family.”  

Drop a 🙏 if you stand with this, or type your own request below.
